verdict.rationale: Tailscale offers automation primitives (webhooks, IaC providers, tsnet for embedding in Go programs, ephemeral GitHub Actions runner integration) that let a tailnet be configured and connected programmatically, which could underpin background automations, but there is no evidence of an agent/automation framework, scheduling, or AI-specific orchestration capability—only networking automation for infra devops use cases. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-agent-oriented automation/orchestration, scheduling or workflow engine, and any AI-native persona-specific tooling beyond generic IaC/webhooks.
